Name: Readable Location Names
Author: asdnex5432
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Adds readable English and Chinese names for locations in vanilla Stardew Valley and supported expansion mods.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
2. Extract `ReadableLocationNames` into your game's `Mods` folder.
3. Launch through SMAPI. No configuration needed.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Readable names for locations in vanilla Stardew Valley and supported expansion mods.
- English and Chinese translations.
- Applies all names through `Data/Locations.DisplayName`.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- SMAPI 4.0.0+.
- Content Patcher 2.0.0+.
- Event Lookup (optional; see Compatibility below).[/color]

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Tested with Event Lookup 0.2.9. Event Lookup is optional and is not required to load this content pack.
Other interfaces that use the game's location display names may also benefit, but have not been individually tested. Interfaces that display internal IDs need separate support.

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to the SMAPI, Content Patcher, Event Lookup, and expansion mod developers.[/color]

Manifest.Name: Readable Location Names
Manifest.Description: Adds readable English and Chinese location names for vanilla and supported expansion mods, used by Event Lookup and other interfaces that read game location display names.
